purpose: Join one checked DomainSpec graph and its registered TypeScript, Python and Rust plans into exactly 39 explicit metatype-language cells before qualification evidence is evaluated.
cell_identity: The ordered pair of one of the 13 backend metatypes and one of typescript, python or rust. Catalogue registration alone does not satisfy a cell.
required_bindings: exact checked source manifest and graph certificate shared by all three plans
supported-input decoder and semantic obligations from the pinned compilation configuration
one or more pinned generation contract sources
actual registered child generator plan identities
every generated native module that owns a selector of the metatype
native compile or import, independent surface observation, normalized positive and hostile semantic cases, and language-specific negative controls

normalization.values: Compare tagged domain values and qualified concept identity, not source bytes, class names or incidental native layouts.
normalization.failures: Preserve semantic failure family, stage and commit uncertainty; ignore incidental stack traces and language prose only where an explicit transport map exists.
normalization.collections: Lists preserve order and repeated occurrences. Sets compare canonical semantic members without imposing one native iteration order.
normalization.identity: Entity identity, complete Value Object equality, Enum or sum discriminants, Event occurrence identity and Workflow step occurrence identity remain distinct.
normalization.effects: Compare declared effect intent, ordering and settlement outcomes. Never normalize an unexecuted intent into an executed effect or indeterminate commit into noncommit.

states: Matrix construction emits not-executed cells only. A separate fresh qualification run may mark a cell passed only when all required observation classes execute; missing, skipped, capacity-limited or unavailable evidence remains explicit.
claim_ceiling: Closed verification input and accounting, not native execution, cross-language qualification, admission, release or publication.
